author: KEXP
description:
Fort Worth, Texas five-piece trauma ray deliver a heavy set of shoegaze on their latest release 'Carnival.' Filling the KEXP Live Room with soaring vocals and hefty arrangements, the band share a performance of "Hannibal" and more.

Watch the full Live on KEXP session on our listener-powered YouTube channel.
title: trauma ray - Live on KEXP
